question: Which of the following sportspersons was awarded the Padma Bhushan in January 2022 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Devendra Jhajharia has become the first para-athlete to receive the Padma Bhushan, the country's third-highest civilian award.
 
• He has won many Paralympic medals, including his first gold at the 2004 Paralympics in Athens.
 
• Avani Lekhara, a para-shooter, was also awarded the Padma Shri award in the Sports category.
 
• She is the first Indian woman to win two Paralympic medals in the same Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/886d74c42ac639898ebbb58726262c221136a7f7dee03975fd2d072b76b7f3b1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Devendra Jhajharia won a silver medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• Along with Jhajharia and Lekhara, President Ram Nath Kovind also conferred Padma Shri award to Vandana Katariya.
 
• She also made history by becoming the first Indian woman to achieve a hat trick at the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games.
